description_en: Queries the category directory tree of an enterprise knowledge base, with support for sorting by a specified field
description_zh: 查询企业知识库的分类目录树，支持按指定字段排序
name: ListKnowledgeBaseDirectories

parameters.help_en: The tenant ID. This is a common parameter. You can pass it explicitly by using --tenant-id in winnexo-cli
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID，公共参数；winnexo-cli 通过 --tenant-id 显式传入
parameters.name: tenant_id

parameters.help_en:
The field by which the results are sorted. Valid values:

event_time: event creation time
event_execute_start_time: event execution time
event_execute_finish_time: event completion time
parameters.help_zh:
返回结果按照哪个字段排序，可选值如下：

event_time：事件创建时间
event_execute_start_time：事件执行时间
event_execute_finish_time：事件完成时间
parameters.name: sort_field

parameters.help_en: The sort order. This parameter takes effect only when sortBy is specified. Valid values: ASC, DESC (case-insensitive)
parameters.help_zh: 指定排序顺序，sortBy填写时生效。可填值：ASC,DESC(大小写不敏感)
parameters.name: sort_order
